{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently too high when prices are rising, showing 0.3-0.6% lag behind true outcomes",
    "When sentiment is positive (>=0.67), model underforecasts by 0.4-1.2% in the first 10-day horizon",
    "True outcomes exhibit more volatility than model forecasts, especially in the first 15 days where range is 10-12 points vs model's 6-point range",
    "Model fails to capture sentiment-driven price bumps, showing flat forecasts while prices move 0.5-2% based on sentiment signals",
    "When prices are in a downtrend, model overforecasts by 0.4-0.8% relative to observed declines",
    "Sentiment alignment rule: when sentiment shifts from 0 to 1, prices tend to 0.3-0.6% higher than model predicts",
    "Mean reversion bias: model maintains levels too steadily, missing 30-40% of true price reversals in the first week"
] }
